styleProfile.background: white and near-white bands, thin rules, sparse cards
styleProfile.composition: single-column clarity, whitespace-first layouts, thin dividers, compact proof rows
avoid: do not force the old navy/red palette if form colors or style words point elsewhere
do not repeat the same heading plus 3-card grid in every section
avoid heavy dark blocks and noisy technical decoration
styleProfile.summary: minimal precision; spacious; soft geometry; white and near-white bands, thin rules, sparse cards; single-column clarity, whitespace-first layouts, thin dividers, compact proof rows

typography.displayFamily: Barlow Semi Condensed, Barlow, Arial, sans-serif

components.primaryButton: clean rounded CTA with arrow icon
components.secondaryButton: transparent or white outlined rectangular CTA

icons.sprite: inline SVG symbols injected by framework

rules: Use the same palette and spacing tokens in every section, but vary section composition according to the style profile.
Style profile: minimal precision; spacious; soft geometry; white and near-white bands, thin rules, sparse cards; single-column clarity, whitespace-first layouts, thin dividers, compact proof rows
Every generated business section must include one scoped style tag as its first child.
Selectors must be prefixed with the current section id.
Use semantic section/article/list markup that can become a WordPress block.
Use <svg><use href="#icon-name"></use></svg> for framework icons instead of inventing new icon paths.
Avoid unscoped .container, .grid, .card, body, html, :root, header, footer selectors.
